apps.localizedDescription:
VidGrab:

A video downloader for iPhone. Paste a link, pick a quality, done. Or open the built-in browser, play a video, and tap the Download button that pops up on it.

I made this because I wanted something simple that just works on my phone, without jailbreak tweaks or a pile of extra packages to install.

Made by T4MAG0 · github.com/iamjhe08.

What it can do:

• Browse sites inside the app and grab whatever video is playing, and copy a video's direct link.
• Ad blocker in the browser.

• Saves videos as MP4 so they play right away and can go into Photos.
• Save just the sound as MP3 or M4A.
• Keeps YouTube videos in their original language instead of a dubbed track.
• Favorites you can add, rename and rearrange.

versions.localizedDescription:
New:

• Theme Gallery: Built-in themes and your own themes now sit in one list. Tap the theme button, then tap a theme to use it. New themes: Midnight Blue, Emerald and Sunset.
• Custom Themes: Make as many as you like. Pick an accent color or type a HEX code, then use a color, gradient, photo or texture as the background. Advanced Colors lets you change text, cards, buttons and more. You can rename, duplicate, delete, export and import your themes.
• Backup and Restore: Settings > Backup and restore saves your settings, themes and saved playlists to one file, and brings them back later. It replaces Export and Import settings.
• Clock and Temperature: In the landscape player, a small pill with the time and temperature slides in at the top right when the controls hide. It softens after a few seconds so it does not distract you. Turn it on or off in Settings > Gestures.

• Spinning CD Cover: Tap the album art in the music player to turn it into a round CD that spins while the song plays. Tap again to go back. You can turn it off in Settings > Audio.
• Copy Links: Settings > About now has your Jailbreak repo and Sideload source links with a copy button.
• Arabic: VidGrab is now available in Arabic. Pick it from the globe button on Home.

Improved:

• The music player now remembers your Shuffle and Repeat choices.

Fixed:

• VidGrab no longer closes when you open Settings on iOS 27.2 beta.
